test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a key principle of the QUAD's (Quadrilateral Security Dialogue) approach to the Indo-Pacific region?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Inclusivity**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Quadrilateral Security Dialogue** (QUAD) is a strategic diplomatic forum comprising four democratic nations: the **United States**, **India**, **Japan**, and **Australia**.
 
• A primary objective of the **QUAD** is to promote a **Free and Open Indo-Pacific** (FOIP), which is anchored in the principle of **Inclusivity**, ensuring the region is accessible to all nations and not subject to the hegemony of any single power.
